SET @lambda_evt := (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt) / (60 * NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d),0)), 0)
  FROM (
    SELECT DATE(created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `VettaFi`.superpixel_resolution_log
    WHERE created_at >= @now - INTERVAL @lookback_days DAY
      AND WEEKDAY(created_at)=@dow AND HOUR(created_at)=@hr
    GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
  ) x
)

SET @lambda_raw := (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt) / (60 * NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d),0)), 0)
  FROM (
    SELECT DATE(stored_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM pixel.raw_events
    WHERE client_name=@client
      AND stored_at >= @now - INTERVAL @lookback_days DAY
      AND WEEKDAY(stored_at)=@dow AND HOUR(stored_at)=@hr
    GROUP BY DATE(stored_at)
  ) x
)
